summary: Siskiyou County lookout on Gray Butte above Panther Meadows. 1930-31 newspaper clippings describe the station; the county index lists it as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source we read describes what remains of a lookout on the butte.
facts.agency: Shasta-Trinity National Forest (called the Shasta National Forest in 1931)

access.note: Hiking trail from Panther Meadows on national forest land; no source describes access to any lookout remains

visit.trail_note: Trail from Panther Meadows. The Forest Service gives 4.0 miles round trip and 2 hours; the trail association gives 3.4 miles round trip. Season late June (July or August in heavy snow years) to late October.

events.note: One of the lookouts is stationed on Gray Butte (Siskiyou Daily News, July 31, 1930)
Forest Service intended to erect a modern, standard lookout station on the butte that fall
Shasta National Forest road camp planned at Wagon Camp to build a forest road to Gray Butte, where the lookout station is located

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1931 clipping says Shasta National Forest; the trail association now names Shasta-Trinity National Forest as controlling agency
Trail length differs: Forest Service gives 4.0 miles round trip, trail association gives 3.4 miles; both are reported in the story and neither is preferred

sources.title: Gray Butte trail
sources.publisher: U.S. Forest Service, Shasta-Trinity National Forest (fs.usda.gov)

notes_for_editor: Record (kind unknown, status gone, agency Shasta National Forest) is consistent with the county index and the 1931 clipping; the agency is updated to the current Shasta-Trinity name in facts, not changed in the record. Two 1930-31 newspaper items give the only history; neither says whether the planned modern station was built, and the story does not claim it was. No source found describes the lookout's remains or whether the summit is reachable beyond the hiking trail. The trail length conflict (4.0 vs 3.4 miles) is reported as is. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 6 page reads.
